description: Header file declaring functions for retrieving network interface statistics on Linux, including interface, VAP, VLAN, and radio stats.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getInterfaceStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a specific network interface.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getAllVapStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for all VAPs associated with a radio.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getAllEpStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for all endpoints associated with a radio.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_acculumateUpperVlansStats
methods.description: Aggregates statistics for upper VLANs on a given interface.
